name: Acceptance
source:
Made in a one month time limit for [url=http://itch.io/jam/jamforleelah]Jam for Leelah[/url], Acceptance is a visual novel adaptation of a Twine game made around three years ago by a Trans woman in the early stages of gender transition.

Designed to reflect some of the day to day challenges of early transition, Acceptance sets out to put players who strongly identify with their birth gender in a position where they have to experience some of the more challenging aspects of how it feels to live life while trans.

[From [url=http://laurakindie.itch.io/acceptance-jam-for-leelah-entry]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Acceptance》是在一个月期限内为[url=http://itch.io/jam/jamforleelah]Jam for Leelah[/url]制作的视觉小说，改编自一名处于性别转换早期的跨性别女性约三年前制作的Twine游戏。

《Acceptance》旨在反映性别转换初期的日常挑战，让那些强烈认同出生时性别的玩家置身其中，体验跨性别生活所面临的一些更艰难的感受。

[来源：[url=http://laurakindie.itch.io/acceptance-jam-for-leelah-entry]itch.io[/url]]
